preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 0 < len(stdin) <= 30 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Input is a non-empty string of lowercase Latin letters with length at most 30.

postconditions.expression: stdout in [substring for substring in all_substrings if (count := count_substring(substring, stdin)) == max_count] and max_count == max(count_substring(substring, stdin) for substring in all_substrings)
postconditions.description: Output is a substring of stdin that appears most frequently. If multiple substrings have the same maximum count, the one with the greatest length is chosen. If there is still a tie, the lexicographically latest substring is selected.
